items.title: Meta’s new AI agent just got me $250 in flight credits
items.summary: In the Loop host Ejaaz Ahamadeen recounts how Muse, Meta's (META) new AI agent, helped get him $250 in flight credits and rebooked a new flight after his original flight was delayed, demonstrating how users can now interact with an agent that handles web-based tasks on their behalf and shifts the role of the operational driver from human to AI.

items.title: Meta has 'enormous advantage' in rally sparked by new Muse AI
items.summary: Meta Platforms (META) stock is trying to hold onto gains from its latest rally fueled by the release of its new Muse AI chatbot. Is this another big moment for the Big Tech company or are investors still wary of trust concerns? Today's Market Hang panel consists of Host Turney Duff, Yahoo Finance Executive Editor Brian Sozzi, Defiance ETFs CIO Sylvia Jablonski, Interactive Brokers chief strategist Steve Sosnick, and Gerber Kawasaki Wealth & Investment Management CEO Ross Gerber.
